about: JTEKT India Ltd., established in 1984, manufactures steering systems and driveline components for passenger cars, utility vehicles and light commercial vehicles. Products include rack-and-pinion manual steering gears, hydraulic power steering systems, recirculating ball screw assemblies, column-type electric power steering (CEPS), steering columns /Intermediate shafts and Constant Velocity Joints (CVJ) [1]
